title: RANCH BEAUTY - 3Bd/2Ba, King Bed, Mins to Broadway
description:
Welcome to Linda Lane, a newly renovated ranch home, with an open-plan & vaulted ceilings. Our comfortable home sits on a 1 acre wooded property, adorned with a seasonal creek. Make yourself right at home in this quiet neighborhood, 10 minutes from The Grand Ole Opry and just minutes from the hustle and bustle of Downtown/Broadway and Airport. Perfect for a family vacation, reunion or gathering of friends. We look forward to hosting you.

The space
- 1,700 sq ft of living space 
- Comfortable sleeping arrangements for up to 6 guests  
- Free driveway and street parking  
- Private coded entrances, no key needed  
- Free internet and Streaming Apps  
- Large Screen HD TV  
- Fully outfitted Kitchen  
- Full-size washer and dryer  
- Patio lounging w/ umbrellas and furniture

If you're looking for more space: 2 more Bedrooms and another Bath?
Then visit the Alternative Page for this Listing called:
RANCH BEAUT - 5Bd/3Ba, King Beds, Mins to Broadway

Guest access
Guests will have use of the entire upstairs Main Level  (3 Bdr/2Ba) space and the upper patio seating area and yard. A maximum of 6 guests are allowed when booking this listing. Sofa or Floor Sleeping is not allowed. Onsite and Street Parking are available. Garage Parking is not available to guests.

Other things to note
We supply the things you need for a comfortable stay. We stock the house with enough paper towels, toilet paper and other toiletries for a long weekend. Guests are responsible for any additional supplies or laundering (washer & dryer available) you may need throughout your stay.
